title: Salmon with tahini greens
summary: Salmon with tahini greens is a middle eastern dinner built around salmon fillets and baby spinach, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat salmon fillets dry and season it. Prep baby spinach and tahini for Salmon with tahini greens so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook salmon fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook baby spinach and tahini in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Salmon with tahini greens before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice salmon fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
